name: tashan
description: 他山 · 教学创作与分享，管理员分配账号的教学项目平台

scripts.prestart: npm run check:runtime && npm run catalog
scripts.check:runtime: node -e "const [major, minor] = process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (major < 22 || (major === 22 && minor < 13)) { console.error('他山账号开发需要 Node.js 22.13 或更新版本；当前为 ' + process.version); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.predev: npm run check:runtime && npm run catalog
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && npx wrangler dev --port 4176
scripts.build: npm run catalog && npm run check && python3 scripts/build-release.py && node tests/release-package.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/library-catalog.mjs && node tests/library-storage.mjs && node tests/library-local-flow.mjs && npm run test:accounts && npm run test:projects && npm run test:cloud-tools && npm run test:ai && npm run test:examples && node --test tests/live-site-verification.mjs
scripts.test:accounts: node tests/account-api.mjs && node tests/local-accounts.mjs && node --test tests/account-ui.mjs tests/account-access-intent.mjs && node tests/account-onboarding-policy.mjs
scripts.predev:cloud: npm run check:runtime && npm run catalog
scripts.test:cloud-tools: node scripts/cloud-check.mjs --self-test && node scripts/cloud-storage.mjs --self-test && node scripts/migrate-local-accounts.mjs --self-test
scripts.test:projects: node tests/project-model.mjs && node tests/project-api.mjs && node tests/worker-upload-policy.mjs && node --test tests/project-stream-api.mjs tests/project-stream-upload-ui.mjs tests/project-stream-policy.mjs tests/r2-upload.mjs
scripts.pretest:browser: npm run check:runtime && npm run catalog
scripts.test:browser: node tests/account-browser.mjs && node tests/project-browser.mjs && node tests/account-layout-browser.mjs
scripts.test:ai: node tests/ai-api.mjs && node tests/ai-extractor.mjs && node tests/ai-browser.mjs
